description: Upload a file to the workspace media library from a local path or a remote URL (max 50MB; images, video, audio, PDF and common office documents). Returns the stored asset whose `url` can be used in block content and record media fields.

filePath.description: Local file path to upload, resolved on the machine running the MCP server

filename.description: Stored filename (defaults to the source's basename)

folderId.description: Media folder id to file the asset under

url.description: Remote URL whose content is fetched client-side and uploaded

name: upload_media
